run_curate_sunrgbd: run the SUNRGBD dataset curation script to extract images, depth maps, and intrinsics into a JSONL file
build_jsonl_from_sunrgbd: build a JSONL file from SUNRGBD scene directories by sampling 100 valid depth pixels per image
extract_camera_intrinsics: extract camera intrinsic matrices from SUNRGBD intrinsics.txt files and compute focal lengths and principal points
compute_euclidean_depth: compute euclidean distances for sampled pixel coordinates using depth values and camera intrinsics
copy_sunrgbd_images: copy SUNRGBD images to an output directory while filtering out NYU dataset entries
